ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

18. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

19. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Food/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Plants ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
